sections.markdown:
## C2 — Focus and road condition confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A172
In a skid you steer in the direction the car is moving and keep correcting, but when hydroplaning you hold the wheel steady and avoid any jerk or overcorrection. [A172]
Why it matters: group_hint traction-loss; prereq_hint sec13-F33; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F35, sec13-F37.
Source: [A172 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0172]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A172
Without antilock brakes, pressing the pedal hard while hydroplaning can make it worse, which is why the guide says to brake gently. [A172]
Why it matters: group_hint traction-loss; prereq_hint sec13-F36; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F37.
Source: [A172 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0172]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A171
Antilock brakes let you keep steering while braking in a skid, whereas without them a quick hard press on the pedal can deepen the skid. [A171]
Why it matters: group_hint traction-loss; prereq_hint sec13-F33; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F34.
Source: [A171 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0171]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A166
High beams are for roads with no oncoming vehicles, and you dim to regular headlights as soon as traffic approaches. [A166]
Why it matters: group_hint night; prereq_hint sec13-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F12, sec13-F13.
Source: [A166 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0166]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A167
Facing an oncoming driver with high beams on, you shift your eyes toward the right side of the road rather than looking into the glare. [A167]
Why it matters: group_hint night; prereq_hint sec13-R04; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F14.
Source: [A167 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0167]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A168
Speed comes off before the curve, stays steady inside it, and builds back gradually on the way out. [A168]
Why it matters: group_hint curves; prereq_hint sec13-F10; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F18, sec13-F20, sec13-F21.
Source: [A168 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0168]

FACT_ID: sec13-R07 | anchor: A169
Inertia is the pull to keep going straight, kinetic energy is what grows with speed, and friction is the grip between tires and road. [A169]
Why it matters: group_hint motion; prereq_hint sec13-F22; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F23, sec13-F24, sec13-F25.
Source: [A169 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0169]

FACT_ID: sec13-R08 | anchor: A171
Bridges, overpasses and shady spots can be icy while the rest of the road is clear, and ice that warms toward freezing turns wet and makes the road more slippery, not less. [A171]
Why it matters: group_hint ice; prereq_hint sec13-F29; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F30, sec13-F31.
Source: [A171 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0171]

FACT_ID: sec13-R09 | anchor: A170
When rain starts on a hot day the danger is at the start, since the road stays very slippery for the first few minutes until the surfaced oil washes away. [A170]
Why it matters: group_hint wet-roads; prereq_hint sec13-F26; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F27.
Source: [A170 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0170]

FACT_ID: sec13-R10 | anchor: A165
Path of travel is the route you drive, while line of sight is only the stretch between you and the target area you chose on that route. [A165]
Why it matters: group_hint attention; prereq_hint sec13-F03; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F07, sec13-F08.
Source: [A165 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0165]

FACT_ID: sec13-R11 | anchor: A164
Central vision is for detail straight ahead, fringe vision is seen but not sharp, and peripheral vision is what lies to your sides. [A164]
Why it matters: group_hint attention; prereq_hint sec13-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F06.
Source: [A164 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0164]
